content_units: Nairobi Student SIM Plan Snapshot
For a six-month stay, the best fit is the plan that balances   monthly cost  ,   10+ GB data  ,   hotspot access  , and enough value for messaging plus occasional video calls.
Based on your priorities,   Plan A is the best overall  , and   Plan D is the strongest budget-friendly alternative that still meets your requirements  .
Plan-by-Plan Comparison
Plan   Monthly Cost   Data   Hotspot   Calls/Extras   Validity   Fit for Your Priorities
Plan A     900 KES       12 GB     Yes   200 minutes   30 days     Best overall balance
Plan B     700 KES     8 GB   Yes   Unlimited on-net calls   30 days   Cheapest, but fails 10 GB minimum
Plan C   1100 KES   15 GB   No   300 minutes   30 days   Good data, but fails hotspot requirement
Plan D   950 KES     10 GB     Yes   100 minutes + unlimited WhatsApp   30 days   Good value, slightly pricier than A per GB
Best Picks for a 6-Month Stay
Best Overall: Plan A
-   Why it wins:   Lowest-cost option that still gives   more than 10 GB   and   hotspot  .
-   Value check:   12 GB is more comfortable than 10 GB for messaging, maps, browsing, and occasional video calls.
-   Call allowance:   200 minutes is solid for a student who mostly uses chat apps but still needs normal calls sometimes.
-   Six-month cost:     5,400 KES
Best Budget Option: Plan D
-   Why it’s the budget pick that still qualifies:   It meets your hard requirements:   10 GB  ,   hotspot  , 30-day validity.
-   Extra strength:     Unlimited WhatsApp   is especially useful for everyday student messaging.
-   Trade-off:   Costs   50 KES more per month than Plan A   while giving less total data and fewer call minutes.
-   Six-month cost:     5,700 KES
Student Value Verdict
Ranked recommendation
1.   Plan A   — best overall value
2.   Plan D   — best lower-data qualifying backup with strong messaging value
3. Plan B — only if absolute lowest price matters more than your 10 GB minimum
4. Plan C — not suitable because hotspot is not allowed
Why Plan A beats Plan D
-   Cheaper:   900 KES vs 950 KES
-   More data:   12 GB vs 10 GB
-   More minutes:   200 vs 100
- Both allow hotspot and last 30 days
Best use-case match
-   Mostly WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, light browsing, some video calls:     Plan A
-   Heavy WhatsApp messaging and moderate data use, but still want 10 GB minimum:     Plan D
Planning Context for 6 Months
Using the same plan for six months:
-   Plan A total:     5,400 KES
-   Plan D total:     5,700 KES
-   Plan B total:     4,200 KES   but below your data target
-   Plan C total:     6,600 KES   but no hotspot
Plan A gives the strongest long-stay value because it saves money versus D while giving more usable data headroom.
